rationale: Given the unanimous vote and Roberts’s stated preference for a narrow, institutionally cautious resolution, the Court is most likely to reverse on Article III standing/traceability-redressability grounds and vacate the sweeping injunction without reaching broad First Amendment merits. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas/Gorsuch/Barrett/Alito to clarify state-action/coercion standards or to emphasize limits on government “persuasion” versus unconstitutional pressure.
